en: This is a black-and-white postcard image showing a pavilion styled as a North/East African mosque, featuring a prominent minaret and surrounded by lush palm trees. The top of the postcard reads 'Exposition Coloniale Internationale – Paris 1931.' Underneath the image is the caption: 'Pavillon de la Côte Française des Somalis'. The architect's name, 'Ch. Wulffleff Arch. D. G.', is also visible.
